I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), and opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **Why v2.3.0:** It is the most recent production release marked healthy. v2.3.1 is unhealthy in production, and v2.3.1-rc was only deployed to staging.
- **Result:** Every region is on v2.3.0. The service reports healthy with an error rate of 0.002, down from 0.18 on v2.3.1.
- **Incident:** The first attempt to create the incident timed out. I retried with the same idempotency key, and it was created once as INC-0001. The description covers the rollback and the post-rollback status.
- **Still open:** v2.3.1 was not redeployed and needs investigation before any future release. Recovery on v2.3.0 should be confirmed over time.
